item.title: Introduction to CSRF and CORS
item.description: Introduction Before introducing CRSF(Cross-site request forgery)&CORS(Cross-origin resource sharing), we first introduce HTTP. If readers are familiar with HTTP, they can skip this content directly. HTTP request ﻿An HTTP request consists of four parts: request line, request header, blank line and request body. 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 GET /mix/76.html?name=kelvin&password=123456 HTTP/1.1 Host: www.fishbay.cn Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1 User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_11_5) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/56.
